fact: The SAPS Strategic Plan 2025 to 2030, tabled 4 April 2025, lists the Case Administration System/Investigation Case Docket Management System (CAS/ICDMS) among the department's digitalised crime detection and investigation capabilities and sets a medium-term deliverable to enhance case docket management of 50% functionality integration in 2025/26, 75% in 2026/27 and full functionality integration and case tracking in 2027/28; it says modernisation through digitisation is inhibited by poor service delivery from SITA, which provides the department's outsourced IT services, and by its cost.
title: Strategic Plan 2025 to 2030
